# Resource usage registry

Where every item comes from and where it goes, in both directions, from the implemented game only:
`game/data/resources.json` (nodes and the code-defined uses and sources), `items.json`, `recipes.json`,
`quests.json`, `balance.json` (building costs, start kit, caravan) and `NPCBrain.BUYS`. `ResourceNodes`
answers the same questions at run time (`uses_of`, `sources_of`, `chain`). Written by
`tools/check_resources.py --write`. The game has no flour or bread recipe: bread is only in the start kit.

## Code-defined uses and sources

Uses and sources the data files do not show, recorded in `resources.json` with the code they cite.

| Item | Use | What | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hammer` | tool | The smith's tool: it wears 2 with every anvil recipe a villager smith makes (the player needs none). | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::act` |
| `iron_bar` | manor_job | Fittings and nails: bought for repairs and public works, carried to the works yard and used up mending. | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::_public_works` |
| `log` | fuel | Household firewood: every household burns a log from its pantry each night; a household without one is cold (noted, stat burned_log). | `game/scripts/core/world.gd::_new_day` |
| `log` | fuel | Villagers buy a log for the pantry in the evening from a carpenter or the raw-goods merchant. | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::_plan_evening` |
| `log` | manor_job | Bought by the manor for repairs and carried to the works yard (haul), then used up mending (mend). | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::reeve_day` |
| `oak_sapling` | plant | Planted by the player on free grass in front of them (the pack window's Plant button): a sapling that grows into a mature oak by the game clock. | `game/scripts/core/world.gd::plant_tree` |
| `pine_sapling` | plant | Planted by the player on free grass in front of them (the pack window's Plant button): a sapling that grows into a mature pine by the game clock. | `game/scripts/core/world.gd::plant_tree` |
| `plank` | manor_job | Bought for repairs and public works, carried to the works yard (haul) and used up mending (mend). | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::_public_works` |
| `stone` | manor_job | Bought for repairs and public works or quarried for the manor (quarry job), carried to the works yard and used up mending (mend). | `game/scripts/core/manor_work.gd::post_quarry` |
| `wheat` | feed | Livestock feed: keepers and the player put wheat in a pen's trough; each animal eats its feed a meal. | `game/scripts/core/fauna.gd::feed` |
| `wheat` | home_cooking | Households cook pottage over the hearth from pantry wheat (the cook_pottage recipe, no station). | `game/scripts/core/npc_brain.gd::_cook_at_home` |

## Findings

### Dead ends

Items no recipe consumes: the end of every chain. They are eaten, worn or used, sold, or built with.

`ale`, `amulet`, `apple`, `axe`, `blueberries`, `bread`, `copper_ring`, `copper_sword`, `gold_ring`, `hammer`, `herbal_tonic`, `iron_armor`, `iron_helmet`, `iron_sword`, `leather_armor`, `leather_cap`, `oak_sapling`, `pickaxe`, `pine_sapling`, `plain_clothes`, `pottage`, `red_berries`, `roast_meat`, `rotten_apple`, `rusty_pickaxe`, `rusty_sword`, `stone`

### Orphaned items

Items with no source at all: `apple`, `gold_ore`. Items only in the player's start kit: `bread`, `plain_clothes`, `rotten_apple`, `rusty_pickaxe`, `rusty_sword`.

### Recipes needing materials with no legitimate source

- `forge_gold_ring` (anvil): needs `gold_bar`, which nothing in the game produces.
- `smelt_gold` (forge): needs `gold_ore`, which nothing in the game produces.

### Finite resources with no replacement

None of the finite node types: once a seam is worked out, the caravan imports its ore (`boulder, coal_seam, copper_seam, iron_seam, stone_seam`). Gold ore has no source at all (see the exceptions).

### Chains dependent on imports

Items whose only lasting source, once the finite seams are worked out, is the caravan:

`amulet`, `axe`, `coal`, `copper_bar`, `copper_ore`, `copper_ring`, `copper_sword`, `hammer`, `iron_armor`, `iron_bar`, `iron_helmet`, `iron_ore`, `iron_sword`, `pickaxe`, `stone`

Every building needs stone (house, workshops), and the smithy needs iron bars, so all building depends
on caravan stone after the stone seams are gone.

### Nodes at risk of overharvesting

- `coal_seam`: Overharvested: worked out by day 8 (seed 1, no player), ECONOMY_SUSTAINABILITY_PROPOSALS.md section 1.
- `copper_seam`: Overharvested: worked out on day 4 (seed 1, no player), ECONOMY_SUSTAINABILITY_PROPOSALS.md section 1.
- `iron_seam`: Overharvested: the iron seams were worked out on day 10 (seed 1, no player), ECONOMY_SUSTAINABILITY_PROPOSALS.md section 1.
- `stone_seam`: Overharvested: worked out on day 10 (seed 1), 79% of it exported raw by the caravan, ECONOMY_SUSTAINABILITY_PROPOSALS.md section 1.
- `wild_boar`: Overharvested: hunters kill down to the sex-blind floor of 2 adults a wood on day 1; boar stop breeding from about day 79-250 (ECONOMY_SUSTAINABILITY_PROPOSALS.md section 2; LONG_RUN_SIMULATION.md finding 8).
- `wild_rabbit`: Overharvested: rabbits stop breeding from about day 10 (seed 1), frozen at 4 adults (LONG_RUN_SIMULATION.md finding 8).

### Exceptions recorded

Legitimate findings, each with its reason (`resources.json` `exceptions`). The validator fails on any
finding not recorded here.

| Item | Finding | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gold_ore` | no_source | defect | Defect: gold ore is an item, the smith buys it, smelt_gold uses it and the mine code gates it at Mining 3, but no deposit in village.json holds it, no start stock has it and no caravan brings it. So smelt_gold, gold_bar, forge_gold_ring and gold_ring cannot be made. Whether to add gold seams is an owner decision. |
| `gold_bar` | no_source | defect | Follows from gold_ore: its only source is smelt_gold. |
| `gold_ring` | no_source | defect | Follows from gold_ore: its only source is forge_gold_ring. |
| `bread` | start_kit_only | implemented | There is no flour or bread recipe: a loaf comes only in the player's start kit. Eaten for food; nobody buys it. |
| `apple` | no_source | implemented | No tree, recipe or kit gives apples: the item is defined but never made (the start kit has a rotten apple only). |
| `rotten_apple` | start_kit_only | implemented | Only in the player's start kit: spoiled food that harms when eaten. |
| `rusty_sword` | start_kit_only | implemented | Only in the player's start kit; nobody buys it. |
| `rusty_pickaxe` | start_kit_only | implemented | Only in the player's start kit; a slower pickaxe nobody buys. |
| `plain_clothes` | start_kit_only | implemented | Only in the player's start kit; nobody buys them. |
| `iron_ore` | import | implemented | After the iron seams are worked out, the smiths' iron comes only by caravan. |
| `coal` | import | implemented | After the coal seams are worked out, the smiths' coal comes only by caravan. |
| `copper_ore` | import | implemented | After the copper seams are worked out, the smiths' copper comes only by caravan. |
| `stone` | import | implemented | After the stone seams are worked out, stone comes only by caravan, to the raw-goods merchants. |
